previous_assumption: Every machine has a road registration number (machines.registration_number NOT NULL, create contract required it) and the asset code is a user-entered fleet code (required, never generated).
correction: Crawler/tracked equipment has no road registration, so registration_number is now nullable (migration 0038) and optional in createMachineRequestSchema/machineSchema; updateMachineRequestSchema accepts "" to clear it (repo stores NULL). Asset code is now auto-assigned by EquipmentService.createMachine via nextAssetCode (AST-0001 padded, collision-checked against assetCodeExists, seeded by MachineRepository.countByOrganization) when the caller omits it; a user may still override. Web RegisterMachineDialog derives registrationNotApplicable from the chosen subcategory name/code matching /crawl|track/ and disables+clears the field.
